entries.noteEn: Labor and Meretz recommended Gantz; Gesher’s Orly Levy-Abekasis recommended neither candidate (Ynet, 15 March 2020).

cites.quote: 61 חברי כנסת על יו"ר סיעת כחול לבן
58 חברי כנסת המליצו על ראש הממשלה
חברת כנסת אחת בחרה שלא להמליץ

notes: Gesher’s non-recommendation is directly reported by Ynet, not merely inferred from 120 − 61 − 58.

events.textEn: Rivlin tasked Benny Gantz with forming a government.
events.textHe: ריבלין הטיל על בני גנץ להרכיב ממשלה.

cites.quote: President Reuven Rivlin tasked the centrist alliance leader with forming a government

notes: Refusal, not a granted extension. The subsequent two-day extension is recorded separately.
events.textEn: Rivlin initially refused Gantz’s request for a fourteen-day extension.
events.textHe: ריבלין דחה תחילה את בקשת גנץ להארכה של ארבעה עשר ימים.

cites.quote: will not grant Blue and White chairman Benny Gantz a 14-day extension
On 12 April 2020, I decided not to accede to MK Gantz’s request for an extension

notes: Approval before midnight on 13 April, as dated in the President’s 16 April letter reproduced in English by Israel National News (secondary delivery; presidential original not inspected). The 14 April timestamp is the earlier report’s publication time.
events.textEn: Rivlin approved a 48-hour extension of Gantz’s mandate, until Wednesday midnight.
events.textHe: ריבלין אישר הארכה של 48 שעות למנדט של גנץ, עד חצות ביום רביעי.

cites.quote: the president approved a last-minute joint request by the two to extend Gantz’s mandate to form a government by 48 hours
On 13 April 2020, before midnight, I acceded to the request of MK Gantz

events.textEn: Gantz’s extended mandate ended at midnight without a government.
events.textHe: המנדט המוארך של גנץ הסתיים בחצות ללא ממשלה.

cites.quote: his mandate to form a government had ended

events.textEn: Rivlin passed the choice of a candidate to the Knesset for 21 days.
events.textHe: ריבלין העביר לכנסת את בחירת המועמד לתקופה של 21 ימים.

cites.quote: the 21-day period during which the entire Knesset as a whole may select a candidate

events.textEn: After 72 MKs signed a request, Rivlin tasked Netanyahu with forming a government within fourteen days.
events.textHe: לאחר בקשה בחתימת 72 חברי כנסת, ריבלין הטיל על נתניהו להרכיב ממשלה בתוך ארבעה עשר ימים.

cites.quote: following the request of 72 Members of Knesset
you have a period of 14 days to form a government
מסרו למנכ"ל בית הנשיא הראל טובי את חתימותיהם של 72 חברי כנסת

events.textEn: Netanyahu informed Rivlin and the Knesset Speaker that he could form a government.
events.textHe: נתניהו הודיע לריבלין וליושב ראש הכנסת כי עלה בידו להרכיב ממשלה.

cites.quote: he informed President Reuven Rivlin and Gantz, who is currently Knesset speaker, that he is able to form a government

events.textEn: The Knesset approved the 35th government, 73 for · 46 against; Netanyahu became prime minister and Gantz alternate prime minister.
events.textHe: הכנסת הביעה אמון בממשלה ה־35, 73 בעד · 46 נגד; נתניהו נעשה ראש הממשלה וגנץ ראש הממשלה החלופי.

cites.quote: The vote of confidence in the new government passed with 73 in favor and 46 against.

events.textEn: Israel, the United Arab Emirates and Bahrain signed agreements to establish diplomatic relations at the White House.
events.textHe: ישראל, איחוד האמירויות ובחריין חתמו בבית הלבן על הסכמים לכינון יחסים דיפלומטיים.

cites.quote: The USA hosts a signing ceremony for the Abraham Accords

events.textEn: The Knesset dissolved automatically after the deadline to pass the 2020 budget expired.
events.textHe: הכנסת התפזרה אוטומטית לאחר שחלף המועד לאישור תקציב המדינה לשנת 2020.

cites.quote: automatic dissolution of the Knesset due to non-transfer of budget
a deadline to approve a 2020 budget expired on 23 December 2020
The Knesset is automatically dissolved

notes: The Commons Library dates budget expiry to 23 December; the deadline-night sitting was on 22 December. IDI independently confirms automatic dissolution for failure to pass the budget.

events.textEn: Israel launched Operation Guardian of the Walls after Hamas rocket attacks on Jerusalem; a ceasefire took effect on 21 May 2021.
events.textHe: ישראל פתחה במבצע שומר החומות בעקבות ירי רקטות של חמאס על ירושלים; הפסקת אש נכנסה לתוקף ב־21 במאי 2021.

cites.quote: barrages of rockets fired toward Jerusalem
May 2021 Israel-Hamas Crisis
May 10
effective on Friday

notes: During the outgoing 35th government’s caretaker tenure, before the 36th government took office. Reuters chronology published Thursday 20 May dates the ceasefire to Friday. Not duplicated as a k24 term event.
Sequence is supported by both chronologies; no broader cause or claim that either action was unprovoked is asserted. CFR also discusses Jerusalem unrest; the row is not a full conflict history.

gaps: Official results certification and first Knesset sitting records not retrieved.
Presidential letters for the Gantz mandate and its extension were not retrieved directly; contemporary reports quote or describe them.
The 7 May written request is recorded as a formal step; a complete 120-seat updated recommendation round (including non-signatories) was not reconstructed.
The coalition rank split reuses established research rather than equating the entire Blue and White, Labor–Gesher–Meretz or Yamina lists with coalition membership.

confidenceVoteCites.note: Tabulation of both official API pages, not a prose quotation. No abstention rows. Miki Levy (23632) has no result among the 120 sitting members; this establishes non-participation, not physical absence.

confidenceVoteCites.quote: Division 5, chair correction after Avi Dichter reports his uncaptured vote.

government.coalitionSeatsNote: Formal member seats only; null means unresolved membership. Election-list groupings and the investiture roll call are separate quantities. See each role citation and reconciliation.

reconciliation.note: 73 member seats = 73 for; 46 against, zero abstentions, one non-participant (Miki Levy, Yesh Atid–Telem, person 23632). The complete official roll call agrees with all 73 members in the retained first-government rank scheme. Labor faction: Peretz and Shmuli for, Michaeli against; Yamina faction: Rafi Peretz for, the other five against. Those split-faction exclusions are already excluded from the 73, not extra subtractions. The protocol corrects 72 for to 73 after adding Dichter’s uncaptured vote. A vote alone does not prove continuing coalition membership.
